        if remaining_capacity[i] > 100:
            priority_scores[i] = slope1 * remaining_capacity[i]
        elif remaining_capacity[i] > 50:
            priority_scores[i] = slope2 * remaining_capacity[i]
        elif remaining_capacity[i] > 25:
            priority_scores[i] = slope3 * remaining_capacity[i]

    # Apply a penalty for bins that are already very close to being full
